purpose: Retire a stale Prompt-12 runtime root whose recorded provider process is absent while preserving all runtime evidence and releasing the canonical source path for a later separately authorised provider admission.
preconditions: runtime_root is an absolute canonical existing directory
provider-admission.json is an absolute canonical regular file under runtime_root
provider admission schema and runtime_root/fifo_path bindings are exact
recorded provider_pid is syntactically valid and is absent from /proc
provider_process_start_identity is syntactically valid and contains the recorded provider_pid
actuator.fifo exists and is a FIFO
no other live process has the exact runtime_root or fifo_path as an argv token
retirement_root is an explicit absent sibling path under the same canonical parent
fail_closed_reasons: retirement root is not a sibling

mutation_semantics.runtime_root_retirement: atomic same-filesystem rename into the exclusive retirement container
